80288.subject: 🔷 The Daily: Strategy's bitcoin holdings top 848,000 BTC
80288.body:
Strategy buys 334 bitcoin as holdings top 848,000 BTC | Treasury withdraws crypto mixing rule | OKX, NYSE parent ICE joint venture seeks to launch tokenized US stock trading venue | CFTC proposes new federal framework for leveraged retail crypto trading | Umia raises $6.1 million at $18 million FDV

The Daily ( https://www.theblock.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Written by Yogita Khatri | Edited by Kyle Baird

Presented By:

( https://polymarket.us/?deep_link_sub1=THEBLOCK&c=NEWSLETTER&shortlink=94gey3fp&source_caller=api_v2&onelink_id=S8ac&pid=THEBLOCK&deep_link_value=midterms&utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Happy Monday! *Bitcoin* is trading above *$85,800* , while several digital asset treasury companies have added to their holdings in recent days.

In today's newsletter, *Strategy* adds another *334 bitcoin* as its total holdings top 848,000 BTC, the *U.S. Treasury* withdraws its crypto mixing rule, an *OKX* - *NYSE* parent *ICE* joint venture seeks to launch a tokenized U.S. stock trading venue, and more.

Meanwhile, *Strategy* wasn't the only DAT buyer. *Strive* adds ( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-10-05-strive-adds-2000-bitcoin-biggest-buy-since-june-closes-in-mara-417677?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) 2,000 bitcoin in its biggest purchase since June, *Metaplanet* reveals ( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-10-05-metaplanet-sold-10000-btc-in-q3-before-buying-back-11000-btc-to-demonstrate-liquidity-417640?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) it sold 10,000 BTC in Q3 before buying back 11,000 BTC, *Tom Lee* 's *Bitmine* adds ( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-10-05-tom-lee-says-ether-dwarfing-other-macro-assets-as-bitmine-adds-15112-eth-417660?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) 15,112 ETH, and *Visa* and *CoinShares* find ( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-10-05-visa-coinshares-find-growing-crypto-appetite-among-consumers-and-affluent-investors-417642?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) growing crypto appetite among consumers and affluent investors.

P.S. Don't forget to check out The Latent ( https://thelatent.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) , our sister website covering AI. Get The Latent Daily here ( https://thelatent.co/newsletter?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) and all other The Block newsletters here ( https://www.theblock.co/newsletters?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ).

 Inside Defence: Sir Rich Knighton on Europe and Russia

Shashank Joshi

Washington bureau chief


 You can take the man out of the defence beat, but you can’t take the defence beat out of the man. I’ve been in Washington, DC for over a month now, soaking up the politics of this great city. But when Air Chief Marshal Sir Rich Knighton, Britain’s chief of defence staff—that is, the country’s top military officer—passed through town last week, I had to grab him for a chat on Inside Defence.
